about_the_game:
Hunt Grounds is a horror survival game for 1-5 players. Outrun cunning hunters in a deadly, broadcasted bloodsport. Scavenge, craft, and survive the predators stalking the Grounds. Just don’t get caught… and mind the traitor within.

SURVIVE THE HUNT

Hunt Grounds is a survival horror game you can fully experience alone or with others. Create a match, choose a map, fill the Hunt with AI and/or friends, and play.

ENTER THE GROUNDS

A deadly hunter roams the abandoned Hunt Grounds. As a survivor, you’ll search for materials, craft supernatural items, hide in the darkness, and try to escape alive. Every match plays out differently depending on what you discover and what you choose to craft.

BECOME THE HUNTER

Play as one of the Hunters, relentless predators with unique senses and supernatural abilities. Track survivors through noise and fear, cut them off, and end the Hunt your way. 

CRAFT SUPERNATURAL TOOLS

Find strange components scattered across the Grounds and combine them to create powerful relics: time-shifting watches, teleportation charms, chaotic gems, and more. Each item can change the course of a Hunt.

TRAITOR ROLE

Chosen secretly by the Hunter during the match, the Traitor appears to be just another survivor but serves a hidden purpose. Complete the Hunter’s secret task to earn a personal escape route…

AN EVER-EVOLVING HUNT

More Hunters, maps, crafting paths, and supernatural systems will be added throughout Early Access. The Grounds will change.

THE LORE OF THE HUNT

Long before the first survivor stepped into the Grounds, the Hunt was already a ritual, a blood sport orchestrated by masked patrons whose identities remain hidden behind Victorian elegance and immense wealth.

From the shadows, they watch every Hunt unfold, their twisted fascination broadcast across a secret community that thrives on chaos.

The Hunters themselves are invited guests, each taking part in the event to prove dominance, test their power, or satisfy darker urges. Survivors are released into the Grounds as offerings… entertainment for an audience that never shows its face.

In the Hunt Grounds, you’re not just fighting for survival.
You’re performing for those who crave the spectacle.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence and general Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 / AMD RX 570
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i7-6700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD RX 590
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
